problemStatement.formal: \text{In 2D, for smooth initial data, prove global existence and uniqueness of smooth solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations.}
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the 2D Navier-Stokes global regularity result (Ladyzhenskaya 1969): smooth initial data gives global smooth solutions, because vortex stretching vanishes in 2D.
whyMatters: Establishes complete solvability of 2D fluid dynamics
Key contrast with open 3D Millennium Problem
Foundation for PDE formalization in Lean

proven: Global enstrophy bound (Ladyzhenskaya 1969): E(t) ≤ E(0) for all t > 0
Enstrophy is antitone: vortex stretching vanishes in 2D (ω scalar)
Exponential decay under Poincaré inequality: E(t) ≤ E(0)·exp(-2νλ₁t)
Filter.Tendsto formulation of enstrophy convergence to 0
